claim.text: Of the 1,101 primary tumors in the release, 535 have survival, mutation, copy number, RNA and protein data.

fact.label: primary tumors with data in all five layers
fact.code:
import pandas as pd
clin = pd.read_csv('clinical.tsv', sep='\t', index_col=0)
primary = clin[clin['sample_type'] == 'Primary Tumor'].index
layers = [pd.read_csv(f, sep='\t', index_col=0, nrows=0).columns for f in
          ['survival.tsv', 'mutation_gene_level.tsv.gz', 'copy_number_gistic.tsv.gz', 'protein_rppa.tsv.gz']]
# RNA layer is not in this release; see audit notes
have_all = [s for s in primary if all(s in set(l) for l in layers)]
print(len(have_all), 'of', len(primary))

ladder.text: Of the 1,101 primary tumors in the release, 535 have survival, mutation, copy number, RNA and protein data.

claim.text: Luminal A is the largest RNA subtype, accounting for about 62% of primary tumors with an RNA subtype call.

fact.label: primary tumors with a PAM50 RNA-seq call that are Luminal A
fact.code:
import pandas as pd
clin = pd.read_csv('clinical.tsv', sep='\t', index_col=0)
primary = clin[clin['sample_type'] == 'Primary Tumor']
called = primary['PAM50Call_RNAseq'].dropna()
lum_a = called[called == 'LumA']
print(len(lum_a), 'of', len(called), round(100 * len(lum_a) / len(called), 1))
